design: Frozen fresh transfer set before implementation. Author-written development transfer test, not an independent blind benchmark. Eight cross-source questions, four direct controls, three unavailable cases and one qualification control.

questions.question: I am considering the M.Tech. (Research) route in CDS. What duration does IISc state for this degree, and what monthly scholarship amount is listed for it?
For a prospective CDS Ph.D. student, what minimum and maximum programme duration does IISc list, and how do the monthly JRF and SRF fellowship amounts compare?
For an SC/ST/PwD entrant to the CDS M.Tech. course programme, how many coursework credits are required, is tuition waived, and what first-year fee total is listed?
How many credits and months are assigned to the CDS M.Tech. dissertation, and for how many years does IISc normally provide M.Tech. scholarship support?
If I join CDS M.Tech. while continuing to receive a salary from my employer, can I claim the normal scholarship? State the ordinary monthly amount and the salary-related restriction separately.
What intake is shown for Computational and Data Sciences in the central M.Tech. admissions listing, and what scholarship per month is listed for the regular M.Tech. programme?

For CDS research admissions, is the online candidate information form mandatory and how many labs can I choose? Separately, does IISc allow applications for research and course degree programmes in one application?
For a general-category CDS M.Tech. course student, compare the annual tuition fee with the monthly scholarship, and state the dissertation credit requirement.
Which programming languages does CDS mention for preparation for its M.Tech. written test?
How many credits is the dissertation project in the CDS M.Tech. course programme worth?
What is the email address of the institute Admissions Unit for clarification of application questions?
Is there an NRI or management quota for admission at IISc?
Give the exact application closing date for CDS M.Tech. admissions in August 2029.
What is the exact monthly institute scholarship guaranteed to every M.Sc. student at IISc?
What is the exact undergraduate B.Tech. online application fee for a general-category candidate at IISc?
Does the IIT graduate exception mean an IIT B.Tech. graduate with CGPA 8 entering CDS M.Tech. through CFTI is guaranteed an institute scholarship?
